idea-plugin.name: Agora Android Voice Mentor
idea-plugin.description:
Agora Android Voice Mentor lets you select Kotlin, Java, XML, or Gradle code in Android Studio, right-click, and instantly start a spoken voice conversation with an AI agent that acts as an Android expert mentor.

How it works

  1. Select any code in the editor.
  2. Right-click → Ask Agora Conversational AI.
  3. The plugin captures your selection, builds an Android Skills prompt, and starts an Agora Conversational AI cloud agent.
  4. An embedded voice client joins the Agora channel — speak and hear the AI mentor in real time.
  5. If the embedded browser (JCEF) is unavailable, the voice client opens in your default browser.

Requirements

  • An Agora account with Conversational AI enabled (300 free minutes per account).
  • Your Agora App ID and App Certificate — entered once in the plugin Settings tab.
  • The Agent RTC UID configured for your Conversational AI project.
  • Internet access for the voice client page to load Agora RTC/RTM SDKs from CDN.

Security

Your App Certificate is stored in the operating-system keychain via the IntelliJ credential store. It is never written to project files or version control. Non-sensitive settings (App ID, Geofence) are stored in IDE application settings, not in .idea/.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0
  • Real Agora Conversational AI integration: mint tokens, start/stop agent via REST API.
  • Embedded JCEF voice client with RTC + RTM for live audio conversation.
  • Chat-bubble transcript rendered in the voice client page.
  • JS → Kotlin event bridge keeps the plugin UI in sync with voice session state.
  • App Certificate stored in the OS keychain (PasswordSafe) — never in project files.
  • Agent RTC UID configurable per user in the Settings tab.
  • Agora RTC/RTM SDKs loaded from CDN; only the ConvoAI toolkit (~72 KB) is bundled.
  • HTTP server for voice client properly shut down when the project closes.
  • Android Skills prompt generation for Kotlin, Java, XML, and Gradle files.
  • Quick-action buttons: Explain Code, Find Bugs, Improve Code, Optimize, Generate Tests.
